answer: Locks are published in beacon, expire in nadir, and quartz lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 142 aliases thus needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3119 identities would post 2684 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
